articles.title: New Projects and Updated News
articles.summary: The launcher now has a projects home page, and browsing and styling news is easier.
articles.content:
• Added a home page with cards for available projects
• The project catalog refreshes every time the launcher starts
• Cards can display images specified in projects.json
• News without an imageUrl now uses a themed default cover
• If the specified cover cannot be loaded, the news item still appears with a fallback image
